findings.impact: Misleading deployment documentation.

findings.title: ALLOW_SEED differs between root and backend .env.example
findings.impact: Confusing seed permission defaults. Root says ALLOW_SEED=1, backend says ALLOW_SEED=0.

findings.title: CORS_ORIGIN schema is z.string().url() but app.ts splits on comma for multi-origin
findings.impact: Multi-origin CORS config (comma-separated) would fail Zod env parse before reaching app.ts split logic. Single-origin works fine. Current production uses single origin.
findings.rootCause: Schema and runtime logic disagree on multi-origin support.
findings.recommendation: Change schema to z.string().min(1) and validate each comma-separated origin is a URL in parseEnv.
findings.remediationRisk: Low — no runtime behavior change for single origin.

findings.title: Dev and test user seed ID collision (e1000000-...-001)
findings.impact: Dev and test profiles share admin1 ID e1000000-...-001. Running test seed on dev DB would overwrite dev admin1 data via onConflictDoUpdate. Target-safety prevents mixing (BE-038), but collision is source-level.
findings.rootCause: Shared/ids.ts defines common IDs used by both profiles.
findings.recommendation: Use distinct ID prefixes: dev=e1d..., test=e1t... for users.
findings.remediationRisk: Medium — requires updating all seed fixtures and tests referencing these IDs.
findings.regressionTest: grep e1000000 across seeds/development and seeds/test returns 0 overlap

findings.title: Dev and test product seed namespace collision (e3000000-...)
findings.impact: Dev seed products[0]=e3000000-...0001, test seed product[0]=e3000000-...0001. Same IDs. onConflictDoUpdate would overwrite.
findings.rootCause: Test seed reuses dev seed ID namespace.
findings.recommendation: Use e3t... prefix for test products.
findings.regressionTest: grep e3000000 across seeds/development and seeds/test returns 0 overlap

findings.title: Dev seed depends on Unsplash image URLs (network dependency)
findings.impact: Offline dev seed would insert Unsplash URLs as imageUrl. No runtime failure (URL is non-null), but images would 404 if Unsplash is unreachable.
findings.rootCause: Dev seed uses external CDN URLs for realism.
findings.recommendation: Bundle local fixture images for dev seed, or use placeholder URLs.

findings.title: Test UMKM seed references localhost:3001 media fixture
findings.impact: Test seed imageUrl points to http://localhost:3001/media/fixtures/e2e-product.webp. Passes check constraint (non-null) but 404s if fixture not present.
findings.rootCause: Test seed designed for local E2E with e2e-setup.ts fixture.
findings.recommendation: Use a stable placeholder or ensure e2e-setup.ts runs first.

findings.title: E2E setup uses product IDs that collide with dev seed
findings.impact: E2E fixture product IDs e3000000-...0001/0002 same as dev seed. Target-safety prevents mixing.
findings.rootCause: E2E setup reuses dev seed ID namespace.
findings.recommendation: Use e3e... prefix for E2E products.
findings.regressionTest: grep e3000000 across e2e-setup and seeds/development returns 0 overlap

findings.title: Render service named loning-preview, plan free, autoDeploy false
findings.impact: Render free plan has cold starts (15s+ spin-up). autoDeploy=false means manual deploy. Service name 'loning-preview' is misleading if this is production. Production URL is loningmarketplace.onrender.com.
findings.rootCause: render.yaml may describe a preview/staging environment, not production. Production may be a separate Render service configured via dashboard.
findings.recommendation: Clarify with user: is there a separate production Render service? If so, add its render.yaml. If not, upgrade plan and rename.
findings.regressionTest: render.yaml service name matches production URL hostname

findings.title: Vercel rewrite hardcoded to loningmarketplace.onrender.com

findings.title: Media-delete partial failure — asymmetric to upload compensation
findings.impact: Media delete route calls storage.deleteObject inside DB tx callback. If storage delete fails after DB soft-delete, object becomes orphan. media-audit.ts script has refreshMediaOrphans to recover. No data loss — just delayed cleanup.
findings.rootCause: Intentional design — orphan cleaner handles it.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Orphan cleaner is the recovery path.

findings.title: Seed determinism FAILURE — test products.ts uses new Date() instead of SEED_DATES
findings.impact: Clean Run A hash (324c03c2...) != Clean Run B hash (75a4aca5...). Same row counts (3 users, 2 umkms, 2 products) but different content hashes. Root cause: products.ts line 7 'const now = new Date()' used for publishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt. Production catalogUpdatedAt timestamps confirm drift (2026-08-01T11:43:22 vs 2026-08-01T04:22:26).
findings.rootCause: products.ts uses runtime timestamp instead of deterministic SEED_DATES.
findings.recommendation: Replace 'const now = new Date()' with 'const now = SEED_DATES.recent' in products.ts. Add SEED_DATES import.

findings.title: Production database contains development seed data (e2000000-... IDs visible in public API)
findings.impact: Production public API returns deterministic dev seed IDs (e2000000-...001 to e4000000-...201). 12 UMKMs, 52 products. Sitemap contains 'ronaldo' product slug (line 174 of sitemap). Production database was seeded with development profile data, NOT real production data. catalogUpdatedAt timestamps differ across UMKMs (11:43:22 vs 04:22:26) confirming non-deterministic seed was applied.
findings.rootCause: Development seed was applied to production Aiven database at some point. No data migration to real UMKM data has occurred.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) acknowledge this is intentional for MVP/launch with placeholder data, or (b) clear production database and re-seed with real Desa Loning UMKM data via admin UI. The 'ronaldo' product should be investigated and removed.
findings.remediationRisk: High — requires user decision about production data strategy.
findings.regressionTest: Production /api/products returns real UMKM data, not e-prefix seed IDs
